purpose: Diagnostic sensitivity check for the existing exploratory k=9 selection; does not replace Unit IV artifacts or claim an optimum.

input.preprocessing: StandardScaler over full descriptive dataset, consistent with the Unit IV unsupervised specification
input.method: KMeans(random_state=42, n_init=20); silhouette evaluated for k=2..12
input.stability: k=9 refit for seeds 7, 42, 2026, 1234, 31415; pairwise adjusted Rand index

k9_seed_stability.interpretation: Assignments vary by initialization; no strong stability claim is made.

interpretation: The original k=2..9 search had its highest silhouette at the upper bound k=9 (0.172636). In the diagnostic extension to k=10 and k=11 the scores are higher, so k=9 is not established as a global optimum. The scores are modest and seed-dependent. This diagnostic does not modify existing Unit IV outputs.
